note: City of Redfield Parks & Rec campground at the north end of Hav-A-Rest Park, the spit into Redfield Lake off US-212 west: lettered sites A-I on a loop by the west shore and numbered sites 1-10 along the cove, with a comfort station, dump station, picnic shelters, playgrounds, tent areas, boat launch and fishing dock; a park manager supervises. Popular in pheasant season. --Claude
summary: City page + ActivityReg + park map read: $20/night, reservable online up to 48 h ahead else office/FCFS, 30/50 A, 19 sites (A-I, 1-10), Apr 1-mid-Nov (manual). Sites are at the NORTH end of the spit, ~300 m from the pin. Lakefront recommended down to lakeview (nearest sites ~40-45 m behind road + tree row / shelterbelt).
flags: WATERFRONT (re-audit, recommend lakefront -> lakeview): the stored evidence ('drive-in loop sites on open grass ~30-50 m to water on both sides', pin moved onto the south loop) describes the south end of the spit, which the park map shows holds tent camping, a shelter, playground and the boat launch - no RV sites. The 19 pads are at the north end: sites 6-10 (~44.8785,-98.5307) are ~40-45 m from the cove of Redfield Lake across the loop road and a row of spaced young conifers; sites A-I (~44.8785,-98.5329) have a multi-row shelterbelt between them and the main lake, the southernmost spurs (A/B) ~35-40 m from shore through scattered trees. No site clearly on open ground to the water -> lakeview. Replacement evidence: 'Park map (ActivityReg) puts sites A-I on a loop at the NW end and 1-10 on the cove's north shore; Esri 2026-11-21: sites 6-10 ~40-45 m from the cove behind the road and a conifer row, A-I behind a shelterbelt from the main lake -> lakeview'.

PIN MOVE (>250 m): stored 44.8758,-98.5316 is on the south tip of the spit (tent/day-use end), ~300 m from the nearest RV site. Suggest 44.8785,-98.5320 (the junction between the A-I loop and the 1-10 row, beside the comfort station).
BOOKING: none stored -> reservable via ActivityReg (account required to book; rates are posted on the city page, so not a login-to-see-rates case). fcfs 'always' within 48 h of arrival.
SEASON: derived Apr 1-Nov 30 -> Apr 1-Nov 15 ('mid-November'), now manual.
